I stayed at Hotel KRB Greens for almost two and a half months during an official assignment, and overall it was a very pleasant experience. The hotel is quite spacious, and the rooms are large, neat, and clean, which made the long stay comfortable.

The food quality is excellent—simple, homely meals with low oil and minimal spices, exactly what one would want during an extended stay.

The staff deserves special appreciation for their courteous and attentive service. I would like to specifically mention Mr. Rajendra and Ms. Pinki, whose professionalism and helpful nature truly enhanced my experience.

A reliable and comfortable choice for anyone visiting Bahadurgarh. Highly recommended for long official stays.
